column2: You may choose not to apply Stone Calendar’s cost reduction effect.
column3: Outdated (conclusion B, work item ruling-conflicts-4, case 2): written (Gatherer date 2004-10-04, its first batch of rulings) for an Oracle text that reduced costs by "up to" {1}, a choice the player made (the oldest capture found, Forge's card script of 2011-12-30, reads "Spells you cast cost up to {1} less to cast."; the 2004 wording itself wasn't found). The Oracle update that went with Bloomburrow (July 2024) removed "up to" from it and from Catalyst Stone, Flash, Fluctuator, Mana Matrix, Planar Gate and Urza's Filter: the MTGJSON data in taw/magic-search-engine still had it at commit e2b33f13 (2024-07-24) and not at the next, 1e5a15c7 (2024-07-29), which also carries the "enters" templating the CR effective 2024-07-30 adopted. The cost rules didn't change (CR 601.2f "minus all cost reductions", as 409.1f said in 2004): the reduction now always applies (Semblance Anvil, 2011-01-01: "Semblance Anvil's cost reduction effect is mandatory.").
